buildMode.header: The device half runs in Google Chrome's built-in model. The cloud half is connected: drafts and rewrites use gemini-3.5-flash-lite, and the second reader uses gemini-3.8-flash.

offlineDraft.deviceDraftText:
Case Note

A visit was undertaken on 12/11 with Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea present. Mould was noted again in the back bedroom, with an increase in severity observed by the window. The landlord has not responded to two emails sent previously. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the deadline for a benefits form (detail not put back), a letter regarding this was observed on the table. The date of birth provided on the form was 3/3/87. It was agreed that a phone call to the landlord would be made on Monday. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday, with assistance offered by a neighbour, Tomas Brandvold, who is also on the caseload. A risk of rent arrears due to a late form submission has been identified. A follow-up visit is scheduled for 26/11.
